answer: Sybil agents multiply cheaply, so charge them real work upfront: every node must post stake, like a timber beam bearing load, before its votes count. Stake pooled from one source gets discounted, since correlated accounts echo a single controller and shed reputation together. An honest knoll of independent stakers then outvotes any faked crowd. Bottleneck: attacker must fund each identity separately or its whole cluster collapses at once.
